whenToUse: Team calendars in month, week, day and agenda views where events are added, edited and dragged
Room and appointment bookings laid out as one column per resource or as a single day of open slots
Project and campaign plans drawn as color coded bars spanning several days of a month

whenNotToUse.when: A finished full page scheduling workspace, such as a hotel desk, shift roster or clinic
A compact booking card where someone picks a day, then a free time slot, and confirms
A plain date or date range input in a form, with no hours, events or dragging

agentNotes: No example passes `onEventsChange`, so drags, resizes and `apiRef` edits stay in calendar state and are lost on reload
New event ids come from a `useRef` counter that restarts at 0 on every mount, so take ids from your store once events persist
